# The browser block, against a local server at @SITE@ (tests/run.sh starts it).
# Reading pages needs browser-automation: off, it's refused; opening isn't.
browser:open @SITE@/index.html ==> b1
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Probe Home
browser:text ==> !browser-automation
browser:snapshot ==> !browser-automation
browser:list ==> !browser-automation
browser:click #go ==> !browser-automation
browser:cookies save /tmp/never-written.json ==> !browser-automation
expect-shell:test -e /tmp/never-written.json || echo absent ==> absent
browser:reload ==>
